caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a skirt, centered on a plain, light beige background. The skirt is knee-length with a straight, slightly A-line cut and appears to be constructed from a soft-textured fabric rendered in a muted purple hue. Two large, rectangular pockets are present on the front of the skirt, one on each side, and are colored in a light brown or tan shade that contrasts with the purple of the main fabric. The top of the skirt has two blue and white striped ties extending from either side, suggesting a wrap or adjustable waist. The seam of the skirt is visible running vertically down the center, and the hem at the bottom is slightly curved. The background is plain with a slightly textured appearance and includes faint brownish marks in the upper left corner.
title: Man's Apron
